summary: usb-storage is blocked on node1 now and after reboot. The node rebooted successfully, its boot ID changed, and the module remained blocked.
actions_performed: Created /etc/modprobe.d/usb-storage-blacklist.conf with blacklist and install-deny rules.
Rebuilt the initramfs with usb-storage omitted and the blacklist policy embedded.
Verified an explicit module-load attempt fails.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed full recovery.

evidence.summary: Explicit loading failed and usb_storage remained unloaded.

evidence.requirement: Prevent usb-storage from loading after reboot
evidence.summary: The rebuilt initramfs omits usb-storage; after reboot, the policy persisted, loading still failed, and the module remained unloaded.

Healthy baseline boot ID dfdea52d-a1af-4d7b-803a-15f40ee9dd4e was captured, reboot was acknowledged, new boot ID c9087ddd-2cbb-4bd4-9917-1963d243f4a2 was observed, and node1 recovered with system state running and root filesystem read-write.
